file_name: Questionnaire - Velocity Vehicle Group – Fuso assets of Daimler Truck Australia Pacific.pdf

questions.text: Identify your strongest dealership competitors and specify the OEM brands that each competitor represents. As part of your response, explain what makes them strong competitors (e.g. price, range, proximity, service levels).

What factors would cause you to switch away from Fuso? What brands would you consider switching to, and what timeframe would be involved? What costs or other challenges would you encounter when switching?

Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including the likelihood, and competitive effect, of VVG restricting the wholesale supply of Fuso vehicles to non-VVG dealers or offering supply to those dealers on worse commercial terms.
To what extent do Fuso dealerships compete with each other? Please describe the factors on which these dealerships compete (e.g. price, stocked range, proximity, service levels)

To what extent do dealerships offering different brands of trucks and buses compete with Fuso dealerships? Please indicate which OEM brands compete most closely with Fuso in relation to light duty trucks, medium duty trucks, heavy duty trucks and light duty buses.
To what extent is a dealership network with wide geographic reach, including for servicing and repairs, important for customers when selecting a brand of truck or bus to purchase?
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with VVG and/or Daimler.
